description: This file defines various classes for HTTP authentication mechanisms in FastAPI, including HTTP Basic, Bearer, Digest, and general HTTP authentication base class. It includes models for credentials, utility methods for authentication headers, and example usage in docstrings.

classes.name: HTTPBasicCredentials
classes.description: Holds the username and password for HTTP Basic authentication.

classes.name: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
classes.description: Stores the scheme and credentials for HTTP authorization headers.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for HTTP authentication schemes, handles authorization logic and error handling.

classes.name: HTTPBasic
classes.description: Implement HTTP Basic authentication scheme, decodes base64 credentials from headers.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Implement Bearer token authentication scheme, extracts token from Authorization header.

classes.name: HTTPDigest
classes.description: Stub class for HTTP Digest authentication, meant for future extension.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Generates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized error with the appropriate headers.

methods.name: Optional[HTTPBasicCredentials] __call__( self, request: Request )
methods.description: Handles the request, extracts authorization info, and returns credentials or raises errors.
